roles.meaning: The application panel background resolved through AppColor.PanelBackground.
The application selection background resolved through AppColor.Selection.
The normal background of a desktop control surface.
The normal foreground of text rendered on a desktop control surface.
The foreground of disabled desktop-control content.
The active selection or highlight background.
The foreground rendered over the active selection or highlight background.
The selection background when its containing surface is inactive.
The foreground rendered over an inactive selection background.
The background of tooltip and informational popup content.
The foreground rendered over tooltip and informational popup backgrounds.
The foreground rendered over editable or document-window backgrounds.
The standard border of an interactive desktop control.
The application-defined separator and pane border.
The background identifying the soft reset mode.
The background identifying the mixed reset mode.
The background identifying the hard reset mode.
